title: Pooling Sequential Evidence Across Hypotheses: Rate-Optimal Multiple Testing at a Fixed Horizon
summary: We study sequential testing of a fixed family of hypotheses when observations are costly and a sampling horizon is specified in advance. The challenge is to pool evidence for earlier decisions when the number and identities of false hypotheses are unknown, while controlling the probability of any false rejection at level $α$. Existing merges attain the pooled growth rate at a single number of false hypotheses: averaging when one is false, multiplying when all are.
